execution_change: Split the already-preregistered target-only and MTP3 gate into a second non-restarting system service so the immutable graph receipt can be committed independently and a spot/preemption interruption cannot invalidate it.
unchanged: The target-only denominator remains 4 prompts by 96 tokens.
The target-only path must retain exact cross-runtime tokens, less than 1% zero tokens, and at least 0.98x control throughput.
The MTP3 denominator remains 4 prompts by 96 tokens.
Candidate MTP3 accepted throughput must be at least 1.05x control.
MTP3 trajectory and draft-acceptance differences are recorded but are not automatic rejection after numeric and capability gates.
CUTE-20 and four-chunk WikiText remain mandatory only after the system gate passes.
No threshold was changed after observing the graph result.
